name: Crowded-short funding squeeze (1h long, basis-negative + trailing stop)
rationale: MECHANISM (H3 read through the perp-spot basis, with a trailing stop to ride the squeeze): when shorts are crowded the perp trades at a DISCOUNT to spot (negative basis) alongside the negative funding — a corroborating fingerprint of one-sided short positioning. Once a squeeze ignites the cover-chase can run, so a trailing stop (armed after a profit cushion) lets the position ride the self-reinforcing leg rather than capping at a fixed TP. Counterparty: the crowded short forced to cover. Long spot, funding accrues. Entry: funding_rate cross_down through a negative floor AND perp_spot_basis below a negative ceiling (perp at a discount = short crowding) AND ret_Nd above a knife-guard (basing) AND open_interest above a rising floor. DISCONFIRMER: replace the funding cross with a static funding-LEVEL lt — equal performance means no event edge; drop the basis arm — no degradation means basis added no crowding separation. The trailing stop must not just fatten winners on look-ahead: net of fees the squeeze must clear.
catalyst: funding cross_down + perp discount to spot + price basing + rising OI, ridden on a trail
